_meta.description: Heart event #6 for npc_paige: The Ring and the Box

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: [The Archive at night. After Paige told Jack about Wren]

lines.speaker: npc_paige
lines.text: I haven't spoken his name out loud in two years. It felt... strange.

lines.speaker: npc_paige
lines.text: Like opening a door I'd sealed shut.

lines.speaker: npc_paige
lines.text: I've spent five years preserving other people's memories.

lines.speaker: npc_paige
lines.text: But somewhere along the way, I forgot that I'm not a museum.

lines.speaker: npc_paige
lines.text: I'm a person. And a person is supposed to... live.

lines.speaker: npc_paige
lines.text: Wren would be so angry with me. He'd say...

lines.speaker: npc_paige
lines.text: 'Paige, you ridiculous woman, the books aren't going anywhere. Go LIVE.'

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: [She reaches up and unclasps the chain. Holds the ring in her palm]

lines.speaker: npc_paige
lines.text: I'm not discarding this. I'm honoring it. By doing what he'd want.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: [She places the ring in a small archival box. Closes the lid gently]

lines.speaker: npc_paige
lines.text: There. Safe. Preserved. Like everything in this Archive.

lines.speaker: npc_paige
lines.text: Jack. I'm not good at this. I've read a thousand love stories.

lines.speaker: npc_paige
lines.text: I still don't know how to write my own.

lines.speaker: npc_paige
lines.text: But I'd like to try. With you.

options.text: I wouldn't have you any other way.
I've been waiting for you to be ready.

lines.speaker: npc_paige
lines.text: Well then. Shall we start a new chapter?

lines.speaker: npc_paige
lines.text: Wren, if you're listening — he's a good one.
